author: xkcd's What If?
description:
Get a copy of What If? 2 and Randall’s other books at: https://xkcd.com/books
More serious answers to absurd questions at: https://what-if.xkcd.com/

This question comes from Doug, who asks: If you were in a boat directly over the Mariana Trench and dropped a 7 kilogram bowling ball over the side, how long would it take to hit the bottom?

It’s a good thing you mentioned the mass, because of a very surprising fact: Most bowling balls float.
